run_create_finetune_dataset: run the script to convert ASE atoms files into a finetuning dataset with train and validation splits
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from an ASE database training dataset
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database files for training or validation
write_ase_db: write ASE atoms objects with energy and force results to an ASE database file in parallel
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression
